turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily ad spend metric (the closest is Ad spend (EUR), ad_spend_eur, "Ad spend across campaigns, in EUR"), so I cannot give an average per weekday without computing it myself; what it does give is total ad spend by ISO weekday for 1-30 September 2026: Monday 820.0 EUR, Tuesday 1,040.0 EUR, Wednesday 1,060.0 EUR, Thursday 860.0 EUR, Friday 830.0 EUR, Saturday 830.0 EUR, Sunday 830.0 EUR, but Tuesday and Wednesday fall five times in that month and the other weekdays four, so these totals do not rank the weekdays by their daily average. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
